text.description_html:
Bommer 7322-626, Brass Spring Door Pivot Hinge Mortised

Bommer Industries has been in business since 1876, with over 125 years of quality products. Their products are American made with American Metals.

Bommer 7322 Spring Door Pivot Hinge, Mortised Applied (Both Top and Bottom pivots are mortised into the door). Cast Brass construction pivot hinge for doors up to 36 Inches Wide, 2-1/2 Inches Thick with a Maximum Door Weight of 75 lbs.

Specifications of the Brass Adjustable Spring Mortise Pivot Hinge:

  • Finish: 626 Satin Chrome
  • Maximum Door Width: 36"
  • Maximum Door Thickness: 2-1/2"
  • Maximum Door Weight: 75 lbs.
  • Cast Brass Construction
  • Mortise Mounted Pivots
  • Double Acting
  • Maximum Swing: 130º each direction
  • Ball Bearing Pivot
  • Non-Handed
  • Adjustable Spring Tension
  • Flat Door Bracket: For doors not less than 1" thick
  • Flat Jamb Bracket: 1-1/4" Wide
  • Packaged with #12 - 1-1/4" and #10 - 1" Flat Head Wood Screws
  • Bommer 7322 Dimensions (PDF)
  • How to Reactivate Tension on Bommer Spring Pivots

Sold individually as a set, with 1 pivot , 1 each jamb and door bracket, 1 top pivot assembly with jamb bracket, and mounting screw hardware. Enough to do one door.



**This item is Discontinued
